channel.name: Tales By Amy
channel.description:
Welcome to Tales By Amy!

I write and produce original African narrative dramas exploring relationships, life challenges, moral dilemmas, and personal growth. Every story is independently scripted and directed by me, bringing meaningful lessons and compelling characters to life.

I use digital and AI-assisted production tools to visualize my stories, while every script, theme, and creative direction is developed and guided by me.

Follow the journey, subscribe, and join the conversation in the comments!

Tales By Amy — Every story has a lesson.

📩 For inquiries: talesbyamy12@gmail.com

DISCLAIMER: All stories are created for entertainment and storytelling purposes. Characters, names, events, and situations are fictional or dramatised and should not be considered real-life events or factual accounts. Any resemblance to actual persons or events is purely coincidental.
